workItem: Bind canonical GitHub issue-title routing to the repository self-healing work graph without making issue content an instruction surface.
workItemDE: Kanonisches GitHub-Issue-Titelrouting an den Self-Healing-Arbeitsgraph binden, ohne Issue-Inhalte zu einer Ausführungs-Authority zu machen.
scope: GOV-owned issue title -> canonical project folder/Owner/PVC resolver
metadata-only issue dispatch workflow with project label/readback and deduplicated dispatch comment
regression tests and GOV work-package evidence
owner-correct OPS handoff for self-healing-contract/1.0.0 / SH-02.9A integration

correlation.note: PR #1225 changes OPS CI telemetry/Roadmap paths; PR #1211 changes SEO paths. Neither overlaps the GOV issue-intake claim paths.

exitEvidence: Exact [CAPITAL-AI-<PROJECT>] title prefix resolves through docs/projects/README.md@CURRENT_MAIN
Primary PVC relationship resolves through docs/projects/PROJECT_VALUE_CHAIN.md@CURRENT_MAIN; cross-cutting projects remain cross-cutting
Issue body is never executed or treated as instruction authority
Routing mutation is limited to canonical existing project label plus deduplicated dispatch evidence comment
Unknown, malformed, superseded or ambiguous project prefixes fail closed
The workflow cannot write repository contents, create/merge PRs or mutate foreign project code
OPS receives an owner-correct handoff for executable self-healing-contract integration
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
